title: Vocabulary Quiz — Intonation Lesson 3: Free Time
subtitle: Words from the Lesson 3 vocabulary list (free time)

words.def: an activity you do for fun in your free time
words.sent: My favourite ___ is taking photos.

words.def: time when you are not working or studying
words.sent: I read books in my ___.

words.def: something you do regularly for fun
words.sent: Fishing is a popular ___ in my village.

words.def: making you feel calm and not worried
words.sent: A hot bath is very ___ after a long day.

words.def: to relax after work or stress
words.sent: I listen to music to ___ after work.

words.def: to keep your body healthy and strong
words.sent: I go jogging every morning to ___.

words.def: a period of physical exercise
words.sent: I do a short ___ before breakfast.

words.def: the things you need for an activity
words.sent: You don't need much ___ to go running — just shoes.

words.def: a person who is starting to learn something
words.sent: I'm a ___, so please be patient with me.

words.def: doing something as a paid job, very well
words.sent: He plays tennis like a ___.

words.def: a competition with many games
words.sent: Our team won the badminton ___ last month.

words.def: very interested and excited

words.def: having a lot of energy
words.sent: My grandma is 80, but she's still very ___ — she walks 5 km a day.

words.def: making you feel worried and tired
words.sent: My job is very ___ — there is never enough time.

words.def: often, at the same times
words.sent: I go swimming ___ — three times a week.

words.def: to become better or make something better

words.def: something difficult that tests you
words.sent: Climbing a mountain is a real ___.

words.def: working well together in a group
words.sent: Football teaches children ___.

words.def: to start a new hobby or activity

words.def: liking something very much
words.sent: My sister is very ___ gardening.
